searchText: If you folks work on something following up your EPF projects, feel free to keep us posted! Hey guys! Just wanted to share a quick update on what I've been working on since EPF7 🙂 I've been continuing to contribute to Erigon, mostly focusing on SSZ correctness and Gloas-related work in Caplin. A few recent contributions: - Fixed SSZ Merkleization edge cases and payload attestation limits ([#25361](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pull/25361), [#25509](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pull/25509)) — both recently merged. - Worked on ProgressiveList decoding for Gloas withdrawals ([#25781](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pull/25781)) — under review. - Improved execution payload envelope validation ([#25836](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pull/25836)) — merged. I'm hoping to keep contributing to Ethereum protocol development, especially around SSZ and interoperability testing. Looking forward to seeing what everyone else is working on!

Hey guys! Just wanted to share a quick update on what I've been working on since EPF7 🙂

I've been continuing to contribute to Erigon, mostly focusing on SSZ correctness and Gloas-related work in Caplin.

A few recent contributions:
- Fixed SSZ Merkleization edge cases and payload attestation limits ([#25361](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pull/25361), [#25509](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pull/25509)) — both recently merged.
- Worked on ProgressiveList decoding for Gloas withdrawals ([#25781](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pull/25781)) — under review.
- Improved execution payload envelope validation ([#25836](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pull/25836)) — merged.

I'm hoping to keep contributing to Ethereum protocol development, especially around SSZ and interoperability testing.

Looking forward to seeing what everyone else is working on!
